item.venom.symbiote_canister.desc: Something inside is alive. Hold use to let it in.
item.venom.empty_canister.desc: Use on a stunned or wounded symbiote to capture it.
item.venom.sonic_emitter.desc2: Sneak + use to tear your own symbiote off.
form.venom.human.desc: The symbiote sleeps. You look and feel human.
form.venom.empowered.desc: Still human on the outside. Stronger, faster, sticking to walls.
form.venom.suit.desc: The symbiote covers you as a living suit. Gliding, roar, heavy armour.
message.venom.bonded: §8The symbiote flows under your skin. You are not alone anymore.
message.venom.bonded_forced: §8It found you. It is inside you now.
message.venom.unbonded: §8The symbiote tears itself away. You feel empty.
message.venom.too_lively: It is too lively - wound it or stun it with sound first.
whisper.venom.bond.0: Hello. We are going to be very close, you and I.
whisper.venom.bond.1: Do not be afraid. We need each other.
whisper.venom.venom.1: Eyes, lungs, pancreas. So many snacks, so little time.
whisper.venom.venom.3: Let us out. Let us PLAY.
whisper.venom.hungry.2: Feed us. Or we start with your liver.
whisper.venom.starving.0: Too weak... we must hide inside.
whisper.venom.fire.0: FIRE! Get us away from it!
whisper.venom.idle_human.1: We could be so much more. Let us out.
whisper.venom.idle_human.2: Your heart is beating fast. Scared?
whisper.venom.idle_human.3: We are watching through your eyes.
whisper.venom.idle_human.4: This body is weak. We can fix that.
whisper.venom.night.2: Something is moving in the dark. Let us look.
whisper.venom.no_room.0: Not here. Too cramped for us.
whisper.venom.raw.0: Raw. Good. Just how we like it.
whisper.venom.recover.1: That hurt. Do not let it happen again.
whisper.venom.lowhp.0: You are dying. Let us handle this.
whisper.venom.lowhp.1: Stop bleeding. We need this body.
whisper.venom.lowhp.2: Let us out, or we both die.
